summary.description: Isodrin is a white crystalline solid with a chemical-like odour, formerly used as an insecticide.
emission_sources: Use as a pesticide in agriculture where still applied
environmental_impact: Highly persistent in the environment and does not degrade easily
Highly toxic to wildlife with long-term damage to sensitive species
Fat soluble and bioaccumulates through the food chain, leading to widespread environmental contamination

top_sdg_impacts.SDG15_Life_on_Land: Isodrin is highly toxic to terrestrial wildlife and persistent in the environment, causing long-term harm to ecosystems and sensitive species.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Exposure to isodrin can affect human health indirectly through bioaccumulation in the food chain and environmental contamination.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: Due to its persistence and bioaccumulation, isodrin contaminates aquatic environments, posing risks to marine life and ecosystems.
